```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ==========================================================
# PCGR WGS Heatmap + SBS merged biological categories (stacked bar)
#   - Heatmap: shared genes (>= 3 samples), variant class per gene/sample
#   - Top: TMB + Grade
#   - Bottom: SBS merged categories stacked bar (relative contribution)
# Output:
#   pILC_shared_genes_heatmap_with_SBS.pdf
#   pILC_shared_genes_heatmap_with_SBS.png
# ==========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tools)
  library(grid)
  library(data.table)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------
BASE_DIR  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification"
META_FILE <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/WGS_TMB_Grade.csv"
SBS_FILE  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Mutational_Signature/SBS_Merged_Categories.csv"

OUTDIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Mutational_Signature"
dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

OUT_PDF <- file.path(OUTDIR, "pILC_shared_genes_heatmap_with_SBS.pdf")
OUT_PNG <- file.path(OUTDIR, "pILC_shared_genes_heatmap_with_SBS.png")
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------
collapse_consequence <- function(consequence) {
  if (is.na(consequence) || consequence == "") return("Other")
  x <- tolower(trimws(consequence))
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  terms <- unlist(strsplit(x, ","))

  has <- function(pat) any(grepl(pat, terms, fixed = TRUE))

  if (has("splice_acceptor_variant") || has("splice_donor_variant")) return("Splice_Site")
  if (has("stop_gained") || has("stop_lost")) return("Nonsense_Mutation")
  if (has("frameshift_variant")) return("Frame_Shift")
  if (has("inframe_insertion")) return("In_Frame_Ins")
  if (has("inframe_deletion")) return("In_Frame_Del")
  if (has("missense_variant") || has("protein_altering_variant")) return("Missense_Mutation")

  return("Other")
}
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load per-sample CSVs
# -----------------------------
csv_files <- sort(list.files(BASE_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
if (length(csv_files) == 0) stop("No CSV files found in: ", BASE_DIR)

sample_names <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files))

full_data <- list()
gene_list  <- list()

for (i in seq_along(csv_files)) {
  df <- read.csv(csv_files[i], check.names = FALSE)

  if (!("SYMBOL" %in% names(df))) stop("Missing SYMBOL column in: ", csv_files[i])
  if (!("CONSEQUENCE" %in% names(df))) stop("Missing CONSEQUENCE column in: ", csv_files[i])
  if (!("ONCOGENICITY" %in% names(df))) stop("Missing ONCOGENICITY column in: ", csv_files[i])

  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df$SYMBOL[df$SYMBOL == ""] <- NA
  df <- df[!is.na(df$SYMBOL), , drop = FALSE]

  df$Sample <- sample_names[i]
  full_data[[sample_names[i]]] <- df
  gene_list[[sample_names[i]]]  <- unique(df$SYMBOL)
}
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Shared genes (>=3 samples)
# -----------------------------
gene_freq <- table(unlist(gene_list))
shared_genes <- names(gene_freq[gene_freq >= 3])
shared_genes <- trimws(shared_genes)

if (length(shared_genes) == 0) stop("No shared genes found with frequency >= 3.")

# -----------------------------
# Build mutation matrix (genes x samples)
# -----------------------------
mat <- matrix(NA_character_,
              nrow = length(shared_genes),
              ncol = length(sample_names),
              dimnames = list(shared_genes, sample_names))

for (s in sample_names) {
  df <- full_data[[s]]
  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df <- df[df$SYMBOL %in% shared_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  for (g in unique(df$SYMBOL)) {
    sub <- df[df$SYMBOL == g, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(sub) > 1) {
      mat[g, s] <- "Multi_Hit"
    } else {
      mat[g, s] <- collapse_consequence(sub$CONSEQUENCE[1])
    }
  }
}

# Order genes by frequency
pct_altered <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat)) * 100
ord <- order(pct_altered, decreasing = TRUE)
mat <- mat[ord, , drop = FALSE]
pct_altered <- pct_altered[ord]
pct_labels  <- paste0(round(pct_altered), "%")

right_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  "Altered" = anno_text(pct_labels, just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  width = unit(12, "mm")
)

# Oncogenic stars
star_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))

for (s in sample_names) {
  df <- full_data[[s]]
  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df <- df[df$SYMBOL %in% rownames(mat), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  for (g in unique(df$SYMBOL)) {
    sub <- df[df$SYMBOL == g, , drop = FALSE]
    if (any(sub$ONCOGENICITY %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      star_mat[g, s] <- "*"
    }
  }
}
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Load metadata (TMB + Grade)
# -----------------------------
meta <- read.csv(META_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
if (!all(c("Sample", "TMB", "Grade") %in% names(meta))) {
  stop("META_FILE must contain columns: Sample, TMB, Grade")
}
meta$Sample <- trimws(meta$Sample)
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample

# Keep only heatmap samples and in same order
meta <- meta[sample_names, , drop = FALSE]

# Grade -> labels II/III
grade_factor <- factor(meta$Grade, levels = c(2, 3), labels = c("II", "III"))

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Build SBS stacked bar matrix
# -----------------------------
sbs_dt <- fread(SBS_FILE)

sbs_dt[, sample_id := trimws(sample_id)]
sbs_dt[, Biological_Categories := trimws(Biological_Categories)]
sbs_dt[, Relative_contribution := as.numeric(Relative_contribution)]
sbs_dt[is.na(Relative_contribution), Relative_contribution := 0]

sbs_levels <- c(
  "Clock-like/Aging",
  "APOBEC/AID",
  "HR deficiency",
  "MMR deficiency",
  "POLE proofreading defect",
  "Exposure-related",
  "Unknown/Uncharacterized"
)

sbs_dt[, Biological_Categories := factor(Biological_Categories, levels = sbs_levels)]

sbs_wide <- dcast(
  sbs_dt,
  sample_id ~ Biological_Categories,
  value.var = "Relative_contribution",
  fill = 0
)
```
```{r}
# Convert to data.frame to avoid data.table join issues
sbs_df <- as.data.frame(sbs_wide)
rownames(sbs_df) <- sbs_df$sample_id
sbs_df$sample_id <- NULL

# Add any missing samples with zero rows
missing_s <- setdiff(sample_names, rownames(sbs_df))
if (length(missing_s) > 0) {
  add0 <- matrix(0, nrow = length(missing_s), ncol = length(sbs_levels),
                 dimnames = list(missing_s, sbs_levels))
  sbs_df <- rbind(sbs_df, add0)
}

# Reorder rows + columns safely
sbs_df <- sbs_df[sample_names, sbs_levels, drop = FALSE]

sbs_mat <- as.matrix(sbs_df)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Annotations
# -----------------------------
top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TMB = anno_barplot(meta$TMB, border = FALSE, gp = gpar(fill = "grey40"), height = unit(22, "mm"), bar_width = 1),
  Grade = grade_factor,
  col = list(Grade = grade_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

bottom_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  "Signature contribution" = anno_barplot(
    sbs_mat,
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(fill = sbs_colors[colnames(sbs_mat)]),
    bar_width = 1,
    height = unit(35, "mm")
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_annotation_name = TRUE
)

# Legends
star_lgd <- Legend(
  labels = "Oncogenic",
  type = "points",
  pch = "*",
  legend_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  title = "Oncogenicity"
)

sig_lgd <- Legend(
  title = "Signature category",
  at = names(sbs_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(sbs_colors))
)

```
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Annotations
# -----------------------------
top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TMB = anno_barplot(
    meta$TMB,
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey40"),
    height = unit(22, "mm"),
    bar_width = 1,
    ylim = c(0, 12),   # important for fixed scaling
    axis_param = list(
      at = c(0, 3, 6, 9, 12),
      labels = c("0", "3", "6", "9", "12"),
      side = "left",
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
    )
  ),
  Grade = grade_factor,
  col = list(Grade = grade_colors),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

bottom_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  "Signature contribution" = anno_barplot(
    sbs_mat,
    border = FALSE,
    gp = gpar(fill = sbs_colors[colnames(sbs_mat)]),
    bar_width = 1,
    height = unit(35, "mm"),
    ylim = c(0, 1),   # because relative contribution
    axis_param = list(
      at = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0),
      labels = c("0", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.0"),
      side = "left",
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_annotation_name = TRUE
)

# Legends
star_lgd <- Legend(
  labels = "Oncogenic",
  type = "points",
  pch = "*",
  legend_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  title = "Oncogenicity"
)

sig_lgd <- Legend(
  title = "Signature category",
  at = names(sbs_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = unname(sbs_colors))
)
# -----------------------------
# Heatmap
# -----------------------------
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Variant",
  col = variant_colors,
  na_col = "grey90",
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_anno,
  right_annotation = right_anno,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,   # cleaner (no sample names)
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white"),
  height = unit(120, "mm"),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(star_mat[i, j]) && star_mat[i, j] == "*") {
      grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
    }
  }
)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Print
# -----------------------------
draw(
  ht,
  annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd, sig_lgd),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)

pdf(OUT_PDF, width = 11, height = 9)
draw(
  ht,
  annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd, sig_lgd),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)
dev.off()

png(OUT_PNG, width = 3600, height = 2800, res = 300)
draw(
  ht,
  annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd, sig_lgd),
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)
dev.off()

message("[DONE] Wrote:\n  ", OUT_PDF, "\n  ", OUT_PNG)
```
